settings.title: IP quality detection
settings.description: Query all enabled services and combine their metrics. Matching results are merged; conflicting results retain their sources. Turn off every service to use only IPPure. ipapi.is can query without a key; cleanip.io and IPinfo require credentials. IPinfo tries Lookup first, then Lite if access is denied; Lite provides basic country and ASN data only.
settings.privacy: Keys and tokens are stored unencrypted on this device, outside profile backups, and sent only to their own service over HTTPS (ipapi.is in the request body, cleanip.io in X-API-Key, IPinfo in Authorization). Detection services receive the queried IP and the request egress IP.
settings.empty: No detection service added. Only IPPure public detection will be used.
settings.httpsRequired: Use a valid HTTPS address for detection services, or leave it blank for the default.
settings.keyRequired: Enter an API key / token for this service, or turn it off.
